title: Common definitions (PROVISIONAL serialisation conventions)
description: PROVISIONAL. The syntax of registryId, registryRef.registry, capabilityName, digest and semverRange is subject to cross-registry reconciliation. Every serialisation convention lives in this file (and tools/src/ids.ts); nothing else in the codebase should depend on the exact syntax.

registryId.description: PROVISIONAL stable object identifier. Filesystem-safe by construction: it is used verbatim as a directory name (see tools/src/layout.ts). No structure inside the id is meaningful to tooling.

registryName.description: PROVISIONAL registry/type discriminator for cross-registry references (e.g. 'skills').

semver.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version. (Change classification is PROVISIONAL, see docs/LIFECYCLE.md.)

versionRange.description: PROVISIONAL version or version range for a cross-registry reference.

registryRef.description: PROVISIONAL cross-registry reference, kept STRUCTURED so the string serialisation can change freely. Semantic requirement: registry/type + id + version/range + optional digest.

capabilityName.description: PROVISIONAL abstract capability name. The shared capability/tool/gateway namespace is NOT yet reconciled.

key.description: Local identifier inside a single blueprint (step id, slot name, skill key, capability key).

relPath.description: Relative path inside the same version directory. '..' segments are rejected by the validator.

effectClass.description: AgentGit-inspired tool-effect classification (vocabulary only; no AgentGit dependency).

actor.description: Governance identity. Placeholders (prefix 'PLACEHOLDER-') are rejected in a production registry root.
